svg.title: AOD-9604's six human trials, all funded by its developer
svg.desc: AOD-9604's six human trials, all funded by its developer. METAOD001, IV, single doses, 15 people: Safety and dosing only. METAOD002, IV, single doses, 23 people: No significant weight loss. METAOD003, Oral, single doses, 17 people: No significant weight loss. METAOD004, Oral, 7 days, 36 people: 1 week; no statistics given. METAOD005, Oral, 12 weeks, 300 people: Mixed; full results unpublished. METAOD006 (OPTIONS), Oral, 24 weeks, 502 people: Primary endpoint missed.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
